name: ai-maestro-maintainer-agent
description: MAINTAINER role-plugin for AI Maestro. Polls a GitHub repository for new issues, triages bugs, and fixes valid issues autonomously via clone-branch-test-publish workflow.

ai-maestro-plugin.reason: Provides the PRRD/TRDD/kanban governance scripts the maintainer-prrd-trdd-kanban skill invokes (get-prrd.py, prrd-edit.py, findprrd.py, findtrdd.py, kanban.py under scripts/prrd-trdd/). Without it those commands are silent runtime failures.
